blueprintStages.name: Discover
blueprintStages.detail: Identify primary sources including official manufacturer websites, government EV portals (e.g., VAHAN, FAME-II), automotive aggregators (e.g., Zigwheels, CarDekho), and e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Flipkart) that list electric two-wheelers in India. blueprintStages.name: Collect
blueprintStages.detail: Systematically scrape or API-pull candidate listings from identified sources. Focus on models explicitly listed under ₹2 lakh. Capture raw HTML/JSON data including all visible specifications and metadata.

blueprintStages.name: Extract
blueprintStages.detail: Parse structured data from collected listings. Extract required fields (Brand, Model, Price, Range, Battery capacity) and capture source URLs for verification. Normalize price to INR and range to km.

blueprintStages.name: Clean
blueprintStages.detail: Standardize extracted values: convert battery capacity to kWh, ensure consistent units for range (km), validate price formats, and correct brand/model naming conventions (e.g., 'Ola S1 Pro' vs 'Ola S1Pro').

blueprintStages.name: Deduplicate
blueprintStages.detail: Merge identical models listed across multiple sources. Use brand-model-price as primary key. Retain highest-confidence source for each unique record.

blueprintStages.name: Validate
blueprintStages.detail: Cross-reference extracted specifications with official manufacturer specs or government databases. Flag records with discrepancies >10% in range or battery capacity.

blueprintStages.name: Identify gaps
blueprintStages.detail: Audit dataset for missing required fields or conflicting values. Generate report of records needing verification or additional sourcing.

blueprintStages.name: Verify
blueprintStages.detail: Targeted verification for flagged records via manufacturer websites, dealer confirmations, or regulatory filings. Update values and confidence scores based on evidence quality.

blueprintStages.name: Publish
blueprintStages.detail: Compile final structured dataset with confidence ratings (85%+ threshold). Include source citations for every value. Export in JSON/CSV with audit trail of transformations and verifications.
